# CRM ALQUIM(IA)

> Open-source AI sales OS: a multi-tenant CRM where AI agents help operate sales and support over WhatsApp. For any business that sells through conversations (e-commerce, clinics, real estate, info-products, services). MIT-licensed, no paid tier. It installs locally with one command (Docker), on the computer of whoever runs it.

Key facts:
- Category: open-source CRM / AI sales operating system / WhatsApp customer platform
- AI: per-tenant RAG agents (pgvector) that answer, qualify and move leads; audited AI→human handoff; per-org AI budget. AI comes switched off and only turns on with an API key the user adds.
- MCP: internal MCP server — AI agents can operate the CRM through the same rules as the REST API
- WhatsApp: via Evolution API (QR connection), with anti-ban pacing, media and STOP detection. The outbound sender starts in simulation; real sending needs two explicit switches.
- Multi-niche: configurable vocabulary per pipeline (lead = Customer/Patient/Buyer; won = Paid/Booked/Closed)
- Compliance: multi-tenant Postgres RLS (isolation tested in CI), LGPD by design (redact, data_request, anonymization), append-only audit log
- Stack: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Supabase (Postgres + Auth + Realtime + Storage, run locally by the Supabase CLI), Evolution API
- License: MIT. Self-hosted: the data stays on the machine where it is installed.
